newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods diffs weaken late, NYMEX declines.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods diffs weaken late, NYMEX declines.

text.p: U.S. spot product prices slid lower by late Monday as both the NYMEX basis and differentials weakened in thin market activity.
NYMEX April heating oil shed 0.26 cent by the close, while April gasoline fell 0.79 cent.

U.S. Gulf (USG) gasoline differentials were the weakest of the bunch, as offers for conventional unleaded M3 barrels for delivery on the back 7th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline fell to 4.25 cents under by the end of the day, traders said, down nearly 1.0 cent on the day. Offers for conventional M2 for the same period slipped 0.25 cent to 3.75 cents under.
New York Harbor (NYH) gasoline differentials also slipped lower, with prompt conventional barrels changing hands at 2.25 cents under the April, down about 0.30 cents on the day.
Market activity was very quiet for most of the day as traders finished up February bookkeeping and tried to define the market following the roll in NYH to April futures from March.

NYH No. 2 oil diffs also weakened, with prompt barrels offered at 0.70 cent over the NYMEX after starting the day at 1.10 cent. That drop was in addition to the nearly 0.50 cent lost in the basis roll from March to April futures.
